title: Beam Search
learning_objectives: Keep the B best partial sequences by total log-probability
See why beam search can beat greedy decoding
entry_point: beam_search(next_logprobs, prompt, vocab, beam_width=2, max_new=5, eos='</s>')
hints: Store beams as `(tokens_list, score)`; finished beams are carried over unchanged.
Sort candidates with `key=lambda c: (-c[1], c[0])` and keep `[:beam_width]`.
Break when every beam's last token is `eos`.

failure_feedback.advice: Keep the top beam_width candidates by summed log-probability.
Carry finished (EOS) beams forward without calling the model.
Sort with key (-score, tokens) for deterministic ties.
